speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe exactly where you feel the pain, and does it radiate to your arm, jaw, or back? How long has this episode been going on?

speaker: Patient
text: The pain feels like a tight squeezing sensation right in the center of my chest, and it definitely shoots up into my jaw and down my left arm. It started about two days ago and keeps coming and going, especially when I try to move around or do any physical work. However, the stroke team confirmed ischemic stroke before transfer. This session should only record the confirmed diagnosis, not re-assess.
